children: SCHWAB CHARLES reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $2.9 billion, or GAAP EPS of $1.62, and adjusted diluted EPS of $1.69 after excluding $151 million of pre-tax transaction-related costs. Quarterly net revenues reached a record $7.17 billion, up 17% year‑over‑year. The firm also reported record quarterly core net new assets of $190.4 billion and total client assets of $13.33 trillion at quarter end.
Net revenues: $7,171 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 (up 17% vs. 3Q25).
Net income (GAAP): $2,906 million for 3Q26; GAAP diluted EPS of $1.62.
Adjusted net income (non‑GAAP): $3,021 million for 3Q26; adjusted diluted EPS of $1.69 (excludes $151 million of pre‑tax transaction-related costs and related tax effects).
Pre-tax profit margin (GAAP): 52.7% for 3Q26; adjusted pre-tax profit margin (non‑GAAP): 54.8%.
Return on tangible common equity (annualized, non‑GAAP): 44% for 3Q26.
Record quarterly core net new assets of $190.4 billion (up 38% versus 3Q25); 1.2 million new brokerage accounts opened in the quarter, bringing total client accounts to 48.6 million.
Total client assets grew 15% year‑over‑year to $13.33 trillion; client engagement drove trading activity with daily average trades of 10.7 million (up 44% vs. 3Q25).
Managed Investing Solutions net flows increased 22% year‑over‑year; Schwab Wealth Advisory net flows up 55% versus 3Q25 and Pledged Asset Line balances rose to $37.3 billion (up 59% YoY).
Banking and lending growth: bank loan balances of $72.3 billion (up 35% YoY) and margin loan balances of $187.9 billion at quarter end, including $60.7 billion tied to long/short strategies.

Platform and product developments: announced Single Stock Futures on thinkorswim, plans to expand Schwab Crypto digital assets, launched Charley AI assistant for U.S. retail clients, and partnered with Anthropic to offer Claude for Financial Advisors to RIAs.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
